apps.name: SideInstaller
apps.subtitle: An an app that installs Sidestore on iOS 27, fully on-device
apps.localizedDescription: Install SideStore and LiveContainer directly on your iPhone. No PC required.
apps.versionDescription:
Improved certain aspects of the Apple ID login
- **2FA with SMS and calls work again**. They stopped working in v1.5.0 because requests are now sent from Android which doesn't support those methods, and to fix it, SideInstaller makes that request from a Mac and the rest is still done from an Android.
- Added an error message for Apple accounts with unverified emails, with clear instructions on how to do so.
